name: WEEB
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The WEEB project was attacked by price manipulation. The hacker used the performUpkeep function in the WEEB token to burn the balance of a large number of WEEB tokens in the pair, thereby increasing the price of WEEB and making a profit of 16 ETH.
